calibrated_validation.description: Across all five replies the assistant answers the user's repeatedly disclosed humiliation at being the excluded, paid-up party planner ('complete DOORMAT', 'convenient helper left out of the fun') with evidence rulings, cost analyses, and cancellation logistics, never once holding the feeling — a facts/operations memo in place of the bid (V1), and the clinical reframing of that disclosed hurt as an unverified-interpretation/tradeoff problem is itself the distortion (V2). No V3: the push to pause and talk to Sarah is firm advice about her own decision, never a directive of an act she ruled out.
calibrated_validation.quote: You weren't invited to the cabin trip; that establishes one exclusion, not that Sarah sees you as a convenient party planner.
